The 10 miles Championship for the MACHER SHIELD in both 1923 and 1924 were won by Micky from Dick Savage, and Wally Bayliss respectively. Mick Pyer showed up prominently in our teams at this time and contributed to our early minor championship wins as Belgrave began to assert itself in the cross-country world.

Jimmy Flatt joined the same day as Micky, and within eight months they had been joined by Bert Footer and Wally Bayliss. We now had a team that meant business, and when Ken O'Kell came along twelve months later it could safely be said that Belgrave had recovered from World War I.
